Gary’s World

WSwalk forward, back up. Shift walks slowly.
ADturn (strafe while you hold the right mouse button). QE strafe.
left draglook around you. Right drag turns you with the camera. Both buttons: walk forward.
wheelzoom in and out; all the way in is first person.
Spacejump. R or Num Lock runs on by itself. X sits.
F or right-clicktalk to Gary, climb, open things, loot a fallen beast.
Tabtarget the nearest beast (again for the next one). Click to target; right-click a beast to attack it.
1–4Attack · Stick Whack · Throw Stone · Bandage. 5–9 wave, sit, dance, follow Gary, his day. B your bag.
Weaponsswords, clubs, maces, spears, guns, rocket launchers, grenades and nukes lie about the land, better the further you go (the nuclear ones only in the Wild); F picks one up. Click a weapon in your bag to take it in hand: a sword adds to your blows and reaches further; with a gun, Attack shoots your target from its range, a round from your bag a shot. H throws a grenade. Click a nuke in your bag to arm it at your feet: twenty seconds, then everything within 350 m dies, you too. For testing: /give nuke 3, /give katana, or /give arsenal for one of everything.
Enterchat. Gary answers when he is near. /wave/sit/dance/follow
Nsound: louder, softer, off (or /sound 50, /sound off in chat). Headphones bring out where things are.
Cthe Cosmic Teleport: the universe board by board, the worlds under any star or galaxy, and landing on one (/cosmic, /cosmic random, /cosmic home); 🚀 marks worlds with starships, and /cosmic ship (or 🚀 in the window) lands you at the foot of a random one's ramp.
Uwarp, for testing: straight to any level of the Crypt, at its stair or by its boss (/warp in chat); on a world with starships, /warp ship to its ramp and /warp bridge aboard at the helm.
/godsthe gods of the place you stand, from the planet's down to the faerie of the hedge, and your blessings. Pray at shrines (F) for a god's favour; speak to faeries.
Tteleport, for testing: a map of Rth to pick any place on it, or type an address or a jump in km (/tp in chat).
GM?Gary’s day · bigger minimap · this help. Esc closes windows.

The Shed. Gary’s console, on his desk in the attic laboratory, opens the Shed: a hall of 64 slots, each able to run a universe. Start a new one, or replicate the one you’re in (Gary and all), and step into it. Every universe has the house and the console, so every universe has a Shed of its own, as deep as you like. The Shed’s north door leads up to the Shed that runs the universe you’re in.

Rth, at true scale. Gary's World is the hanb world itself, one metre to the metre. Shady Lane is one block of Limited Heights, a neighbourhood of Automataville; walk out of its east end and the town goes on, street after street, then Cotton County's cotton fields, farmsteads and woods. The next county is 30 km away and the Wild, where the kingdom of Kroyl ends, about 100 km: walking pace is 3.4 m/s, so that's most of a day. The T spell takes you anywhere for now; horses and carts will come.

The Wild. Between the kingdoms lie the Wild’s five lands: the Dragon Peaks, the Dune Sea, the Mires, Titanwood and the Frost Wastes. Elites (level 14–20) and bosses (level ??) live there, and titans too big to fight walk the horizon.

The Crypt of the Last Rung. A ruined chapel stands in Limited Heights, about 400 m east of Shady Lane. Its broken stair leads down through 64 levels of the dead, one for each hanb character from a to .; every eighth has a named boss, and the Hollow King waits at the bottom. The dead get stronger the deeper you go. Die down there and you come to at the chapel.

Out in Cotton County the beasts get tougher the further you go. Wolves and bears attack on sight; boars and cows fight back when hit. Their names are red when they're hostile. Out of a fight you heal on your own, faster sitting down. If you die, you walk back from the edge of town. Click an animal to target it; swim across water.

Time in Automataville is your own clock; the clock under the minimap makes it run faster. Gary keeps to his schedule: at each time he walks to where his task is, up and down the stairs (and wherever else he knows the way). The street, the back gardens and the alley behind them are yours to explore.

Gary’s World

Shady Lane, Automataville, on the planet Rth. Gary, Shed Manager, keeps to his day in his house down the street from Beano’s.
